recipes.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
steps: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente
Fry bacon until crispy
Mix eggs with parmesan
Combine pasta with bacon and egg mixture off heat
Season with black pepper and serve

recipes.name: Margherita Pizza
steps: Preheat oven to 220C
Stretch pizza dough on baking sheet
Spread tomato sauce evenly
Add mozzarella and basil
Bake for 12-15 minutes until crust is golden

recipes.name: Butter Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices for 1 hour
Fry onions and garlic until golden
Add ginger and cook for 1 minute
Add chicken and cook until brown
Add tomato sauce and simmer for 15 minutes
Add cream and butter, cook until thickened

recipes.name: Pad Thai
steps: Soak rice noodles in warm water for 30 minutes
Heat oil in wok and fry garlic
Add shrimp and cook until pink
Push aside and scramble eggs
Add noodles and sauce, toss to combine
Add bean sprouts and peanuts, serve with lime

recipes.name: Grilled Salmon
steps: Preheat grill to medium-high
Mix olive oil, minced garlic, and dill
Brush salmon with oil mixture
Season with salt and pepper
Grill for 6-8 minutes per side
Serve with lemon wedges

recipes.name: Vegetable Stir Fry
steps: Cut vegetables into bite-sized pieces
Heat oil in wok
Add garlic and ginger, cook for 1 minute
Add harder vegetables first
After 3 minutes add peppers
Pour soy sauce and toss
Garnish with sesame seeds

recipes.name: Caesar Salad
steps: Wash and tear romaine lettuce
Toss with caesar dressing
Add croutons and parmesan
Top with anchovies
Drizzle with lemon juice and serve

recipes.name: Tacos al Pastor
steps: Mix chili powder, cumin, and lime juice for marinade
Marinate pork for 2 hours
Grill pork until cooked through
Slice pork thinly
Grill pineapple slices
Warm tortillas
Assemble tacos with pork, pineapple, onion, and cilantro

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and tikka paste for 1 hour
Bake chicken at 200C for 15 minutes
Saute onions and garlic until golden
Add tomato sauce and simmer for 10 minutes
Add cooked chicken and cream
Simmer for 5 minutes and serve

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 190C
Cream butter and sugar until fluffy
Add eggs and vanilla extract
Mix in flour, baking soda, and salt
Fold in chocolate chips
Drop spoonfuls on baking sheet
Bake for 9-11 minutes until golden brown

recipes.name: Greek Moussaka
steps: Slice eggplant and fry until golden
Brown ground beef with onions and garlic
Add tomato sauce and simmer for 15 minutes
Layer eggplant and meat sauce in baking dish
Mix cream and parmesan for topping
Bake at 180C for 30 minutes until golden

recipes.name: Quinoa Buddha Bowl
steps: Cook quinoa according to package directions
Roast sweet potato at 200C for 25 minutes
Roast chickpeas with spices for 20 minutes
Massage kale with lemon juice and olive oil
Make tahini dressing
Assemble bowl with all ingredients
Drizzle with tahini dressing

recipes.name: Beef Tacos
steps: Brown ground beef in skillet
Season with cumin, chili powder, and garlic
Warm taco shells
Dice lettuce and tomato
Fill shells with beef
Top with lettuce, tomato, cheese, and sour cream
Serve with salsa

recipes.name: Pasta Primavera
steps: Cook pasta until al dente
Cut vegetables into bite-sized pieces
Saute garlic in olive oil
Add vegetables and cook for 5-7 minutes
Toss pasta with vegetables
Top with fresh basil and parmesan

recipes.name: Teriyaki Chicken Bowl
steps: Cook rice according to package directions
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces
Steam vegetables
Cook chicken in skillet until golden
Pour teriyaki sauce over chicken
Assemble bowls with rice, vegetables, and chicken
Garnish with sesame seeds

recipes.name: Beef Stroganoff
steps: Cook egg noodles according to package directions
Slice beef thinly and season
Brown beef in a skillet and set aside
In same skillet, saute onions and mushrooms
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute
Return beef to pan, add broth and simmer for 10 minutes
Stir in sour cream and serve over noodles

recipes.name: Vegetable Curry
steps: Saute curry paste, onions, and garlic in oil
Add potatoes and carrots, cook for 5 minutes
Pour in tomato and coconut milk
Simmer for 15-20 minutes until vegetables are tender
Add peas and cook for 3 more minutes
Serve with rice or naan

recipes.name: Blueberry Pancakes
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt
Whisk eggs and milk together
Combine wet and dry ingredients until just mixed
Fold in blueberries
Heat butter on griddle
Pour batter and cook until bubbles form
Flip and cook until golden brown
Serve with maple syrup

recipes.name: French Onion Soup
steps: Slice onions thinly
Caramelize onions in butter for 40 minutes until golden
Add garlic and thyme, cook 2 minutes
Pour in wine and cook until reduced
Add beef broth and simmer 20 minutes
Ladle soup into oven-safe bowls
Top with baguette slices and cheese
Broil until cheese is bubbly and golden

recipes.name: Avocado Toast
steps: Toast bread until golden and crispy
Mash avocados with lemon juice, salt, and pepper
Spread avocado mash on toast
Top with halved cherry tomatoes
Drizzle with olive oil
Sprinkle red pepper flakes and serve

recipes.name: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Dice chicken and cook in wok until done
Remove chicken and scramble eggs in same wok
Add garlic and stir fry for 30 seconds
Add carrots and peas, cook 2 minutes
Add rice and break up clumps
Return chicken, add soy sauce and sesame oil
Toss everything together
Garnish with green onions

recipes.name: Shakshuka
steps: Saute onion and peppers until softened
Add garlic, cumin, paprika, and chili flakes
Pour in tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes
Make wells in the sauce
Crack eggs into the wells
Cover and cook until whites are set
Crumble feta on top
Garnish with parsley and serve with bread

recipes.name: Beef Burgers
steps: Season ground beef with salt and pepper
Form into 4 patties
Grill patties 4 minutes per side for medium
Add cheese in last minute of cooking
Toast burger buns on grill
Assemble burgers with lettuce, tomato, onion
Add condiments and serve

recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Heat broth in separate pan
Saute onion and garlic in olive oil
Add mushrooms and cook until golden
Add rice and toast for 2 minutes
Add wine and stir until absorbed
Add hot broth one ladle at a time
Stir constantly until each ladle is absorbed
Continue 18-20 minutes until creamy
Stir in butter and parmesan off heat

recipes.name: Chicken Fajitas
steps: Slice chicken and vegetables into strips
Marinate chicken with lime juice and spice mix
Cook chicken in hot skillet until browned
Remove chicken and cook peppers and onions
Warm tortillas in a dry pan
Serve chicken and vegetables with tortillas
Add sour cream and guacamole on the side

recipes.name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
steps: Cook pasta in salted boiling water
Saute garlic in butter over medium heat
Add shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side
Add white wine and lemon juice
Toss cooked pasta with shrimp sauce
Add lemon zest and parsley
Season and serve immediately

recipes.name: Mango Smoothie Bowl
steps: Blend frozen mango and banana with coconut milk
Pour into a bowl
Top with granola, fresh fruit, and chia seeds
Drizzle with honey
Serve immediately

recipes.name: Lamb Kofta
steps: Mix lamb with finely grated onion and garlic
Add spices, mint, salt, and pepper
Shape mixture around skewers
Grill or broil for 8-10 minutes turning
Warm flatbreads
Serve kofta on flatbreads with yogurt sauce
Garnish with fresh mint and lemon

recipes.name: Pho Bo (Vietnamese Beef Noodle Soup)
steps: Char ginger and spices in a pan
Add to broth and simmer 30 minutes
Strain broth and season with salt
Cook rice noodles according to package
Slice beef very thinly
Divide noodles into bowls
Pour hot broth over beef to cook it
Serve with bean sprouts, basil, lime, and sauces

recipes.name: Banana Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 175C
Mash bananas thoroughly
Mix melted butter with sugar
Add eggs and vanilla
Stir in mashed bananas
Fold in flour, baking soda, and salt
Stir in walnuts
Pour into loaf pan and bake 60-65 minutes

recipes.name: Tom Yum Soup
steps: Bruise lemongrass, galangal, and lime leaves
Bring broth to boil with aromatics
Add mushrooms and tomatoes
Add shrimp and cook 3 minutes
Remove aromatics
Season with fish sauce and lime juice
Add coconut milk for creaminess
Garnish with coriander and serve

recipes.name: Eggs Benedict
steps: Make hollandaise: whisk yolks with lemon juice over bain marie
Slowly whisk in melted butter until thick
Season with salt and cayenne
Poach eggs in simmering water with vinegar
Toast English muffins
Warm Canadian bacon
Assemble: muffin, bacon, poached egg, hollandaise

recipes.name: Ramen
steps: Slow cook pork belly with soy and mirin for 2 hours
Make soft boiled eggs, marinate in soy sauce
Bring broth to boil and season
Cook noodles according to package
Slice pork belly
Assemble bowls with noodles and hot broth
Top with pork, egg, corn, and toppings
Garnish with nori and sesame seeds

recipes.name: Greek Salad
steps: Chop cucumber, tomatoes, and red onion
Combine in large bowl
Add olives and crumbled feta
Whisk olive oil with vinegar and oregano
Drizzle dressing over salad
Season with salt and pepper
Toss gently and serve

recipes.name: Beef Burritos
steps: Cook rice according to package directions
Brown ground beef with cumin and chili powder
Season black beans with salt and lime
Warm tortillas
Layer rice, beef, beans, and cheese on tortilla
Add lettuce, sour cream, salsa, and guacamole
Roll tightly folding in sides
Serve immediately or grill for a crispy burrito

recipes.name: Vegetarian Lasagna
steps: Preheat oven to 190C
Saute garlic, zucchini, and mushrooms
Wilt spinach and squeeze out excess water
Mix ricotta with eggs, parmesan, spinach
Spread tomato sauce in baking dish
Layer: noodles, ricotta mix, vegetables, sauce
Repeat layers ending with sauce
Top with mozzarella
Bake 45 minutes until bubbly and golden

recipes.name: Tiramisu
steps: Brew espresso and cool, mix with rum
Whisk egg yolks with sugar until pale and thick
Fold mascarpone into egg mixture
Whip egg whites to stiff peaks
Fold egg whites into mascarpone mixture
Dip ladyfingers briefly in espresso
Layer soaked ladyfingers in dish
Spread mascarpone mixture on top
Repeat layers and refrigerate 4 hours
Dust with cocoa powder before serving

recipes.name: Cauliflower Soup
steps: Chop cauliflower into florets
Saute onion and garlic in butter
Add cauliflower and broth
Simmer 20 minutes until very tender
Blend until smooth
Stir in cream and half the cheese
Season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg
Serve topped with remaining cheese and chives

recipes.name: Bibimbap
steps: Season beef with soy sauce, sesame oil, and garlic
Cook each vegetable separately, season each
Fry eggs sunny side up
Warm bowls and add rice
Arrange vegetables and beef in sections on rice
Place egg on top
Mix gochujang with sesame oil for sauce
Add sauce and sesame seeds, mix before eating

recipes.name: Falafel Wrap
steps: Blend chickpeas with onion, garlic, parsley, and spices
Add flour and form into balls
Refrigerate 30 minutes
Deep fry at 180C until golden and crispy
Warm flatbreads
Spread hummus on flatbreads
Add falafel, lettuce, and tomatoes
Drizzle with tahini sauce and serve

recipes.name: Overnight Oats
steps: Combine oats, milk, yogurt, honey, chia seeds, and vanilla
Stir well to combine
Cover and refrigerate overnight
In the morning, stir and add milk if too thick
Top with berries, banana slices
Drizzle with almond butter and serve cold

recipes.name: Pulled Pork
steps: Mix dry spices to make rub
Coat pork shoulder with rub
Let marinate overnight in fridge
Cook in slow cooker with vinegar for 8 hours on low
Shred pork with two forks
Mix in BBQ sauce
Serve on buns with coleslaw

recipes.name: Caprese Salad
steps: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella to equal thickness
Arrange alternating on plate
Tuck basil leaves between slices
Drizzle with olive oil
Add balsamic glaze
Season with salt and pepper
Serve immediately

recipes.name: Black Bean Soup
steps: Saute onion, garlic, and pepper until soft
Add cumin and paprika, cook 1 minute
Add black beans and broth
Simmer 20 minutes
Blend half the soup until smooth
Return to pot and season with lime juice
Serve topped with sour cream, cilantro
Serve with tortilla chips on the side

recipes.name: Peking Duck
steps: Clean duck and pat dry
Mix honey, soy sauce, and five-spice
Coat duck with mixture
Hang or place on rack to dry overnight
Roast at 200C for 1.5 hours
Rest 10 minutes before carving
Slice skin and meat
Serve with warm pancakes, hoisin, cucumber, and spring onions

recipes.name: Prawn Curry
steps: Saute onion, garlic, and ginger until softened
Add curry powder and turmeric, cook 1 minute
Add tomatoes and cook until broken down
Pour in coconut milk and simmer 10 minutes
Add prawns and cook 4-5 minutes until pink
Squeeze lime juice
Garnish with coriander and serve with rice

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
steps: Season chicken with garlic powder and lemon juice
Grill chicken 6-7 minutes per side
Rest and slice
Toss lettuce with dressing and parmesan
Warm tortillas
Layer chicken, caesar salad, and croutons on tortilla
Roll tightly and slice on diagonal
Serve immediately

recipes.name: Minestrone Soup
steps: Saute onion, celery, and carrots in olive oil
Add garlic and cook 1 minute
Add tomatoes, broth, and parmesan rind
Simmer 15 minutes
Add zucchini and beans
Add pasta and cook until al dente
Remove parmesan rind
Serve with fresh basil and grated parmesan

recipes.name: Chocolate Lava Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 220C
Melt chocolate and butter together
Whisk eggs with sugar until thick and pale
Fold chocolate mixture into eggs
Fold in flour until just combined
Pour into greased and cocoa-dusted ramekins
Bake 12 minutes - edges set, center jiggly
Rest 1 minute, turn out onto plates
Serve immediately with ice cream

recipes.name: Chicken Souvlaki
steps: Cut chicken into 3cm chunks
Marinate with olive oil, lemon, garlic, and spices for 1 hour
Thread onto skewers
Grill over high heat 10-12 minutes turning
Rest 5 minutes
Warm pita bread
Serve souvlaki in pita with tzatziki, tomato, onion, and lettuce

recipes.name: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
steps: Toast bread until golden
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper
Bring water to gentle simmer, add vinegar, poach eggs 3 minutes
Spread avocado on toast, top with poached egg
Sprinkle red pepper flakes and chives

recipes.name: Banana Pancakes
steps: Blend banana, eggs, oats, baking powder, vanilla and cinnamon
Heat buttered skillet over medium
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake, cook 2 minutes each side
Serve with maple syrup

recipes.name: Greek Salad
steps: Chop cucumber, tomatoes and red onion into chunks
Combine vegetables and olives in bowl
Top with feta cheese block
Drizzle with olive oil and vinegar
Season with oregano, salt and pepper

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and tikka paste 30 minutes
Grill chicken until charred
Fry onion, garlic and ginger until soft
Add remaining paste and cook 2 minutes
Add tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes
Stir in cream and chicken, simmer 5 minutes
Serve with rice

recipes.name: Beef Tacos
steps: Brown beef in skillet over high heat
Season with cumin, paprika, garlic powder and salt
Warm taco shells in oven 5 minutes
Assemble tacos with beef, cheese, salsa, sour cream and lettuce
Serve immediately

recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Heat stock in separate pan
Saute onion and garlic in butter and oil
Add mushrooms and cook until golden
Add rice and toast 2 minutes
Add wine and stir until absorbed
Add stock ladle by ladle, stirring constantly 18 minutes
Stir in parmesan and butter
Season and rest 2 minutes

recipes.name: Salmon Teriyaki
steps: Mix soy, mirin, sake and sugar for teriyaki sauce
Heat sauce until sugar dissolves, cool
Marinate salmon 15 minutes
Cook salmon skin-side down 4 minutes
Flip and brush with sauce, cook 3 minutes
Serve over rice with sesame seeds

recipes.name: Lentil Soup
steps: Saute onion, carrots and celery in oil 8 minutes
Add garlic and spices, cook 1 minute
Add lentils, tomatoes and stock
Simmer 25 minutes until lentils soft
Blend half the soup
Season with lemon juice and serve

recipes.name: Chocolate Lava Cake
steps: Preheat oven 200C, grease ramekins with butter and cocoa
Melt chocolate and butter together
Whisk eggs, yolks and sugar until pale
Fold chocolate into eggs
Fold in flour and vanilla
Fill ramekins 3/4 full, chill 30 minutes
Bake 12 minutes until edges set but centre jiggles
Invert onto plates and serve with ice cream

recipes.name: Pad See Ew
steps: Soak noodles in hot water 20 minutes
Stir fry garlic in very hot wok
Add chicken and cook until done
Push to side, scramble eggs
Add noodles and broccoli
Add sauces and sugar, toss together
Serve immediately

recipes.name: Caesar Salad
steps: Blend garlic, anchovy, egg yolk, lemon and worcestershire
Slowly whisk in olive oil until emulsified
Tear lettuce into pieces
Toss lettuce with dressing and half the parmesan
Top with croutons and remaining parmesan

recipes.name: Shakshuka
steps: Fry onion and peppers in oil 8 minutes
Add garlic and spices, cook 1 minute
Pour in tomatoes, simmer 10 minutes
Make wells and crack in eggs
Cover and cook 6-8 minutes until whites set
Top with feta, parsley and serve with bread

recipes.name: Beef Stir Fry
steps: Slice beef thinly, toss with cornstarch
Cook beef in batches in hot wok until browned
Remove beef, stir fry vegetables 3 minutes
Add garlic and ginger, cook 1 minute
Return beef, add sauces and sesame oil
Toss together and serve with rice

recipes.name: Mango Smoothie Bowl
steps: Blend frozen mango, banana and coconut milk until thick
Pour into bowl
Top with granola, fresh mango, chia seeds and coconut
Drizzle with honey

recipes.name: Chicken Fajitas
steps: Mix spices and lime juice, coat chicken and marinate
Cook chicken in hot skillet 6 minutes
Remove chicken, cook peppers and onion 5 minutes
Warm tortillas in dry pan
Serve chicken and vegetables in tortillas with toppings

recipes.name: Vegetable Curry
steps: Dice and boil sweet potato 10 minutes
Fry onion until golden
Add garlic, ginger and spices, cook 2 minutes
Add tomatoes, simmer 5 minutes
Add chickpeas, sweet potato and coconut milk
Simmer 10 minutes, stir in spinach
Serve with rice

recipes.name: French Onion Soup
steps: Slice onions and cook in butter very low heat 45 minutes until golden
Add sugar and cook 5 more minutes
Add wine and reduce
Add stock, thyme and bay, simmer 20 minutes
Toast bread and top with cheese
Ladle soup into bowls, float cheesy toast on top
Grill until cheese bubbles

recipes.name: Prawn Fried Rice
steps: Stir fry garlic and ginger 30 seconds
Add prawns and cook until pink
Push to side, scramble eggs
Add cold rice, breaking up clumps
Add peas, carrots and soy sauce
Toss everything with sesame oil
Top with spring onions

recipes.name: Tiramisu
steps: Make espresso and cool, add amaretto
Beat egg yolks with sugar until pale
Fold in mascarpone until smooth
Whisk egg whites to stiff peaks, fold into mascarpone
Dip ladyfingers in coffee, lay in dish
Spread half the cream mixture
Repeat layers
Dust with cocoa, refrigerate 4 hours

recipes.name: BBQ Pulled Pork
steps: Mix spices and rub all over pork
Cook in slow cooker on low 8 hours
Pull pork apart with forks
Mix with half the BBQ sauce
Serve in buns with remaining sauce and coleslaw

recipes.name: Pesto Pasta
steps: Blend basil, pine nuts, parmesan, garlic and olive oil until smooth
Season pesto to taste
Cook pasta until al dente, reserve pasta water
Toss pasta with pesto and pasta water
Add halved cherry tomatoes
Serve with extra parmesan

recipes.name: Tom Kha Gai
steps: Bruise lemongrass and simmer in stock 10 minutes
Add coconut milk, galangal and lime leaves
Add chicken and mushrooms, cook 8 minutes
Season with fish sauce and lime juice
Add chilli to taste
Serve in bowls topped with coriander

recipes.name: Eggs Benedict
steps: Make hollandaise: whisk yolks over double boiler until thick
Slowly whisk in melted butter, season with lemon and cayenne
Grill bacon and toast muffins
Poach eggs in simmering vinegar water 3 minutes
Assemble muffin, bacon, egg and hollandaise
Garnish with chives

recipes.name: Tabbouleh
steps: Soak bulgur in boiling water 20 minutes, drain
Finely chop all vegetables and herbs
Mix bulgur with parsley, mint, tomatoes, cucumber and onions
Dress with olive oil and lemon juice
Season well and refrigerate 30 minutes

recipes.name: Lamb Kebabs
steps: Mix lamb with grated onion, garlic and spices
Shape around skewers
Grill on high heat 8-10 minutes turning occasionally
Rest 5 minutes
Serve in warm pita with tzatziki, tomatoes and onion

recipes.name: Black Bean Quesadillas
steps: Drain and mash half the black beans
Mix with diced pepper, onion and spices
Spread on half a tortilla, add cheese
Fold and cook in oiled pan 3 minutes each side
Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream and lime

recipes.name: Prawn Linguine
steps: Cook linguine until al dente
Fry garlic and chilli in oil 1 minute
Add tomatoes and cook until bursting
Add wine and reduce by half
Add prawns and cook 3 minutes until pink
Toss with pasta, parsley and lemon zest

recipes.name: Breakfast Burrito
steps: Fry chorizo until crispy
Scramble eggs with salt and pepper
Warm beans in microwave
Warm tortillas in dry pan
Fill with eggs, chorizo, beans, cheese and salsa
Add avocado and spring onions
Roll tightly and serve

recipes.name: Vegetable Biryani
steps: Parboil rice with whole spices until 70% cooked
Fry sliced onions until golden brown
Cook vegetables with yogurt and biryani masala
Layer rice and vegetable mixture in pot
Drizzle saffron milk and ghee over top
Seal pot and cook on very low heat 25 minutes
Serve garnished with mint and fried onions

recipes.name: Tuna Nicoise Salad
steps: Boil potatoes 15 minutes, green beans 3 minutes, eggs 7 minutes
Sear tuna 2 minutes each side
Make dressing with mustard, vinegar, garlic and oil
Arrange lettuce on platter
Top with vegetables, eggs and tuna
Scatter olives and anchovies
Drizzle with dressing

recipes.name: Chana Masala
steps: Fry cumin seeds in oil until sputtering
Add onion and cook until golden
Add garlic, ginger and spice mix, cook 2 minutes
Add tomatoes, simmer 10 minutes
Add chickpeas and 200ml water
Simmer 15 minutes until thick
Squeeze in lemon, garnish with coriander

recipes.name: Overnight Oats
steps: Mix oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds, honey and vanilla
Transfer to jar or container
Refrigerate overnight or at least 4 hours
Top with fresh berries, sliced banana and nut butter
Serve cold

recipes.name: Pho Bo
steps: Char onion and ginger under broiler
Boil bones 5 minutes, drain and rinse
Simmer bones with charred vegetables and spices 3 hours
Strain broth, season with fish sauce and sugar
Slice raw sirloin very thinly
Cook noodles, place in bowls
Add raw beef slices, pour boiling broth over
Serve with accompaniments

recipes.name: Hummus
steps: Drain chickpeas, reserve liquid
Blend chickpeas, tahini, garlic, lemon, cumin and salt
Add reserved liquid to reach desired consistency
Blend 5 minutes until very smooth
Transfer to plate, drizzle with olive oil
Sprinkle paprika and parsley
Serve with pita

recipes.name: Bulgogi
steps: Slice beef very thinly
Mix soy, grated pear, sesame oil, sugar, garlic and ginger
Marinate beef at least 30 minutes
Cook beef on high heat until caramelized
Serve over rice with spring onions and sesame seeds
Wrap in lettuce leaves if desired

recipes.name: Spanakopita
steps: Wilt spinach, squeeze out all water
Mix spinach with crumbled feta, eggs, onion, garlic, dill and nutmeg
Brush phyllo sheets with oil, layer 6 sheets
Add filling, top with 6 more oiled sheets
Score top, bake 180C 45 minutes until golden
Rest 10 minutes before cutting

recipes.name: Beef Bourguignon
steps: Brown bacon, remove and set aside
Brown beef in batches
Cook onions and garlic
Return beef, dust with flour
Add wine, stock, tomato paste and herbs
Simmer covered 2.5 hours until tender
Add mushrooms and carrots last 30 minutes
Serve with mashed potatoes

recipes.name: Sushi Rolls
steps: Cook sushi rice, season with vinegar, sugar and salt
Cool rice to room temperature
Lay nori on bamboo mat, spread thin layer of rice
Add fillings along one edge
Roll tightly using mat
Cut each roll into 6-8 pieces with wet knife
Serve with soy sauce, wasabi and ginger

recipes.name: Minestrone Soup
steps: Saute onion, carrots and celery in oil 8 minutes
Add garlic and cook 1 minute
Add tomatoes and stock
Simmer 15 minutes
Add courgette, beans and cabbage
Add pasta and cook 10 minutes
Season and serve with fresh basil

recipes.name: Moussaka
steps: Slice aubergines, salt and drain 30 minutes
Fry lamb with onion, garlic and spices
Add tomatoes and wine, simmer 15 minutes
Roast aubergine and potato slices until golden
Make bechamel with butter, flour and milk
Layer potato, meat, aubergine in baking dish
Top with bechamel, sprinkle parmesan
Bake 180C 45 minutes

recipes.name: Granola
steps: Preheat oven to 160C
Mix oats, nuts and seeds with coconut oil, honey, cinnamon and vanilla
Spread on baking trays
Bake 30 minutes, stirring halfway
Add cranberries when cool
Add chocolate chips when completely cool
Store in airtight container

recipes.name: Baba Ganoush
steps: Char aubergines directly over gas flame turning often
When collapsed and blackened (20 min), cool
Peel off charred skin
Squeeze out any bitter liquid
Blend aubergine with tahini, garlic, lemon, cumin and salt
Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle paprika and parsley

recipes.name: Chicken Shawarma Wrap
steps: Mix spices, lemon juice and oil, coat chicken and marinate 2 hours
Grill chicken on high 6 minutes each side
Rest and slice thinly
Mix yogurt with grated cucumber for sauce
Warm pita, fill with chicken and salad
Drizzle yogurt sauce and serve

recipes.name: Ramen
steps: Simmer pork belly in soy and mirin 2 hours until tender, slice
Make soft boiled eggs, marinate in soy mixture
Simmer stock with garlic and ginger 30 minutes
Season broth with soy, mirin and sesame paste
Cook noodles per package
Assemble bowls with noodles, hot broth, pork, egg and toppings
Drizzle sesame oil

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Beat butter with both sugars until light and fluffy
Add eggs and vanilla, beat well
Mix in flour, baking soda and salt until just combined
Fold in chocolate chips
Chill dough 30 minutes
Scoop onto lined baking sheets
Bake 180C 10-12 minutes until golden at edges
Cool on tray 5 minutes

recipes.name: Fresh Spring Rolls
steps: Cook vermicelli noodles, rinse with cold water
Prepare all fillings: slice vegetables
Dip rice paper in warm water 15 seconds until pliable
Lay on damp surface, add lettuce, noodles, vegetables and shrimp
Fold sides over filling, roll tightly
Serve immediately with dipping sauces

recipes.name: Paella
steps: Heat saffron in warm stock
Fry chicken and chorizo until golden, remove
Fry onion, garlic and pepper
Add tomatoes and paprika, cook 5 minutes
Add rice and coat in oil
Add saffron stock, bring to boil
Add seafood and return chicken in final 10 minutes
Cook without stirring until stock absorbed
Garnish with parsley and lemon

recipes.name: Coconut Dahl
steps: Fry onion in oil until soft
Add garlic, ginger and spices, cook 2 minutes
Add tomatoes and cook 5 minutes
Add lentils and 500ml water
Simmer 15 minutes until lentils soft
Stir in coconut milk and spinach
Season with lime juice
Garnish with coriander

recipes.name: Smashed Avocado Wrap
steps: Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper
Halve cherry tomatoes, thinly slice onion
Layer greens in wrap
Add smashed avocado, tomatoes and onion
Crumble feta on top
Drizzle olive oil and sprinkle chilli flakes
Roll wrap tightly and serve

recipes.name: Beef Rendang
steps: Blend chillies, shallots, garlic and ginger to paste
Fry paste in oil 10 minutes until fragrant
Add bruised lemongrass, galangal and lime leaves
Add beef and coat in paste
Add coconut milk and bring to boil
Simmer uncovered on low heat 3 hours stirring occasionally
Add toasted coconut when sauce nearly dry
Cook until beef is dark and coated in dry sauce
